svg.title: budget-wa
svg.desc: An open ledger: the Washington budget record, kept by the source that published each part. It stands on the detached base bar that marks the public-record stores. Drawn on the budget-drs app icon's box and rules in one colour, emerald-600 (#059669): solid, no strokes, and every gap at least 2.5 units, which is about 1.4 CSS pixels at 16.
